name: Word Guess
summary: One five-letter word a day, the same for everyone, each on their own private board, with a spoiler-free result to post.
description: Launch it from the apps menu. There is one word a day, the same for everyone in the space, and everyone plays it on their own board, on their own time: your board is private to you, and nobody else sees your letters. Launching shows an empty board with the guess field on it: type a five-letter word to start today's puzzle, or press my board to get back to yours, finished or not. The tiles colour in: green for a letter in the right place, amber for one that belongs somewhere else, an outlined dark tile for one that is not in the word. Six tries a day, then it tells you the answer. Share posts your tries and the tiles as plain text without the word. Practice starts a random board that is not scored, kept for you like the day's. Your guesses are kept in the module's own database (data.store) so a board cannot be replayed, and sharing posts as you (message.post); an admin approves both at install. It needs a server that supports add-on API 2, which adds private scenes.

changes: The daily word is picked the same way on every build, so tests and the published module always agree; the words people get do not change.
Drops a second copy of each response the module kept and never read.
Days are numbered from the launch (day 1 is 1 November 2026) instead of counting from 1970.
Launching shows an empty board with the guess field right on it; typing a word starts today's puzzle, and my board and practice are the two other buttons.
Clearer tiles: empty tiles are outlined, right and misplaced letters have their own letter colours, and the board has a title.
One word a day, the same for everyone (by UTC date), played on a board only you see; finishing one does not show anyone else your letters.
A second launch the same day shows your finished board, and a day cannot be played twice.
Share posts your tries and the tiles as plain text, without the word; the number of days in a row you have won shows on your board.
Practice is the old random board, now private to you and not scored.
Needs add-on API 2 (private scenes) and the data.store and message.post approvals in the Dock.
Each launch gets its own word instead of the same one every time.
